gratings.description: 128 x 128 float32 gratings, period 8 px; OrientationJ tensor=3 gradient=4 (Gaussian); largest |error| in degrees, rounded to 0.0001 (the largest unrounded error was 0.001045) over the central 64 x 64 pixels

example.description: SHG example: OrientationJ tensor=3 with its Gaussian (gradient=4) and cubic spline (gradient=0) gradients against this app's sigma 1, rho 3 (scipy reference), on pixels 16 or more from the border with coherency >= 0.2 and energy >= 1% of max. Energy is compared by correlation only: OrientationJ rescales it.

windowFit.description: fit-window.py: this app's tensor at a grid of sigma and rho against OrientationJ tensor=3 with its Gaussian gradient on the SHG example, on the pixels of example.results. OrientationJ's recursive Gaussian applies nine causal and anticausal first-order passes with a pole chosen so that three passes have variance tensor^2; nine passes have standard deviation sqrt(3) * tensor, 5.196 px at tensor=3 (impulse response computed numerically).
